NOS-DOS: Installing in VirtualBox
==================================
Version 1.0  |  NOS-DOS v1.x  |  See also: QUICKSTART.TXT, README.TXT

This guide walks you through creating a VirtualBox VM and installing
NOS-DOS from scratch using the installer ISO.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
WHAT YOU NEED
------------------------------------------------------------------------

Two files from the NOS-DOS release:

  nosdos-blank.vmdk   Pre-formatted blank hard disk (installer target)
  nosdos.iso          Bootable installer ISO

IMPORTANT: Do NOT create a blank VDI/VMDK in VirtualBox yourself.
The installer requires a disk that is already partitioned and formatted.
nosdos-blank.vmdk provides exactly this -- use it as-is.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 1 -- CREATE THE VM
------------------------------------------------------------------------

Open VirtualBox and click "New".

  Name:           NOS-DOS
  Machine Folder: (your choice)
  Type:           Other
  Version:        DOS

  Memory:         64 MB  (32 MB minimum; 64 MB recommended)

When asked about a virtual hard disk, choose:
  "Use an existing virtual hard disk file"

Click the folder icon, then "Add", and select:
  nosdos-blank.vmdk

Click "Create".

------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 2 -- CONFIGURE THE VM
------------------------------------------------------------------------

With the NOS-DOS VM selected, open Settings.

  SYSTEM tab
  ----------
  Boot Order:
    [x] Optical      <-- must be first
    [x] Hard Disk    <-- second
    [ ] Floppy       <-- uncheck or move below Hard Disk

  STORAGE tab
  -----------
  You should see one storage controller. It MUST be an IDE controller.

  *** If the controller says "SATA" or "AHCI", the CD-ROM driver will
  *** not find the disc. Right-click and remove it, then add a new
  *** IDE controller (click the controller icon at the bottom).

  Under the IDE controller:
    Hard disk slot:  nosdos-blank.vmdk  (already attached from Step 1)
    Optical slot:    click the empty CD icon -> "Choose a disk file..."
                     select nosdos.iso

  AUDIO tab
  ---------
  Enable Audio:        checked
  Host Audio Driver:   (your OS default)
  Controller:          SoundBlaster 16

  NETWORK tab
  -----------
  Adapter 1:
    Enable Network Adapter:  checked
    Attached to:             NAT
    Adapter Type:            PCnet-FAST III (Am79C973)

Click OK.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 3 -- RUN THE INSTALLER
------------------------------------------------------------------------

Start the VM. It boots from the ISO automatically.

You will see the FreeDOS boot messages, then the NOS-DOS installer
appears as a blue TUI screen.

  Screen 1 -- Welcome
    Press Enter to continue.

  Screen 2 -- Pre-flight check
    The installer confirms:
      CD-ROM:  found (D:)
      C: disk: partitioned and formatted  [OK]
    Press Enter to continue.

  Screen 3 -- Confirm installation
    This is the point of no return. Press Enter to begin.

  Screen 4 -- Format
    Press any key to launch FORMAT. When FORMAT asks:
      "Proceed with Format (Y/N)?"  -- press Y, then Enter.
    FORMAT writes the filesystem. This takes a few seconds.

  Screen 5 -- Copy files
    The installer copies NOS-DOS to C:\. A file counter shows
    progress. Copying ~100 files takes about 30-60 seconds.

  Screen 6 -- Done
    The installer displays:
      "Installation complete."
      "1. Remove the installation disc."
      "2. Press Enter to reboot."

    Remove the ISO:
      In the VirtualBox menu bar: Devices -> Optical Drives ->
        Remove Disk from Virtual Drive

    Press Enter in the VM. It reboots from C:.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 4 -- FIRST BOOT
------------------------------------------------------------------------

On the very first boot from the hard disk, NOS-DETECT runs to probe
your virtual hardware (CPU, memory, sound, network). This is normal.

DETECT generates CONFIG.SYS and AUTOEXEC.BAT, then reboots once more.

After the second reboot, NOS-DOS is fully configured:
  - NOS-SHELL launches automatically (dual-pane file manager)
  - Networking is configured (MTCP.CFG has your IP address)
  - All NOS-DOS tools are available

------------------------------------------------------------------------
STEP 5 -- OPTIONAL: TAKE A SNAPSHOT
------------------------------------------------------------------------

After the first successful boot, take a VirtualBox snapshot so you can
always return to a clean state:

  Machine -> Take Snapshot -> Name it "Fresh install"

------------------------------------------------------------------------
TROUBLESHOOTING
------------------------------------------------------------------------

  "AMD-V is being used by another hypervisor (VERR_SVM_IN_USE)"
    KVM is loaded on your Linux host and conflicts with VirtualBox.
    Run as root (or with sudo):
      modprobe -r kvm_amd
      modprobe -r kvm
    Then try starting the VM again. KVM will reload on next reboot.

  Installer boots but cannot find the CD-ROM (no D: drive)
    The storage controller is SATA/AHCI instead of IDE. The CD-ROM
    driver (OAKCDROM.SYS) requires an IDE controller.
    Fix: Settings -> Storage -> remove SATA controller -> add IDE
    controller -> re-attach nosdos-blank.vmdk and nosdos.iso.

  Installer shows "C: disk: NOT FOUND" on the pre-flight screen
    The VM is using a blank VDI you created yourself instead of
    nosdos-blank.vmdk. A self-created blank disk has no partition
    table and no filesystem -- the installer cannot use it.
    Fix: detach the blank VDI and attach nosdos-blank.vmdk instead.

  FORMAT fails or shows Abort/Ignore/Retry/Fail
    Same cause as above -- wrong disk attached.

  Black screen after removing ISO and pressing Enter
    The boot sector on C: was not written correctly. This usually
    means FORMAT did not complete. Start over with a fresh copy of
    nosdos-blank.vmdk (re-run the build, or re-extract from the
    release archive).

  NOS-SHELL does not appear / boots to DOS prompt
    NOS-DETECT did not complete successfully. At the C:\> prompt:
      C:\NOS\SYSTEM\DETECT.EXE /FORCE
    This re-runs hardware detection and reboots.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
VM SPECIFICATIONS (for reference)
------------------------------------------------------------------------

  CPU:        32-bit x86 (no PAE required)
  RAM:        64 MB
  Disk:       ~32 MB (nosdos-blank.vmdk, FAT16)
  CD-ROM:     IDE, ATAPI
  Sound:      SoundBlaster 16
  Network:    PCnet-FAST III, NAT
  Display:    Standard VGA
  Controller: IDE (PIIX4)

------------------------------------------------------------------------
